caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded jug with a short neck and a wide, bulbous body. The jug is brown in color with subtle variations in tone, indicating reflections and the texture of the ceramic surface. It has a single, thick handle attached to the upper part of the body and curving upwards to connect just below the small, circular opening at the top. The background is plain and off-white, with some spots and faint discoloration visible around the edges. The overall composition centers the jug prominently in the middle of the image. There is a faint signature visible in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Stone Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
